pages.text: Health 220, Attack 4, Knockback Resistance 0.6, Movement Speed 0.25.$(br)It swims like the Drowned Necromancer.$(br)$(l)Poison Bolt$(): 4 damage, +2 bolts in the spread per level.

Bloom Orb (unlocked by the Bloom Focus): same damage as the Bloom Focus, each level counts as one level of its Potency; underwater it becomes a biomass mine.$(br)$(l)Heal$(): 5-10, radius 16 blocks, plus Regeneration I for 10 seconds; each level raises the low end by 2.5 and the high end by 5.

$(l)Rally$(): servants within 15 blocks gain Fortitude and Vigor for 15s, plus Speed I for 10s.$(br)$(l)Small summon$(): seven fast-growing vines and one Vinecaller in front, two from level 2.$(br)$(l)Large summon$(): summons a Bear servant.$(br)$(l)Sow Seeds$(): six thorn vines around it plus two Slime servants.

Underwater these become sea anemones and Tropical Slime servants.$(br)$(l)Hunting Focus$(): the small summon brings two Black Wolves beside the Vinecaller, Snappers underwater.$(br)$(l)Spider Nest$(): the Black Wolves may be replaced by Web Spiders.$(br)The two share a cap of 4.

$(l)Leaping Focus$(): the large summon may become a Leaping Leaf, 1 per cast, cap 1.$(br)$(l)Brood Focus$(): the large summon may become a Brood Spider, 1 per cast, cap 1.$(br)$(l)Alpha Wolf Focus$(): the large summon may become a Mist Wolf, 1-2 per cast, cap 2.

$(l)King Spider Focus$(): the large summon may become a King Spider, 1-2 per cast, cap 2, sharing 3 with the Mist Wolves.$(br)$(l)Beetle Nest$(): the Slimes from Sow Seeds may be replaced by one Slime Beetle and one Pinch Beetle, sharing a cap of 2.
